statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-4046 (GLIBC-SA-2026-0007, glibc bug 33980): iconv() in the GNU C Library 2.43 and earlier could abort on an assertion failure when converting input from the IBM1390 or IBM1399 character sets, so untrusted input could crash the calling program. https://sourceware.org/git/?p=glibc.git;a=blob_plain;f=advisories/GLIBC-SA-2026-0007. Upstream fixed it on the 2.41 branch in https://sourceware.org/git/?p=glibc.git;a=commit;h=61737f43b1f0d9f64a6f16649625476b70f9f4d3 (master: d6f08d1cf027f4eb2ba289a6cc66853722d4badc). Debian fixed it for trixie in 2.41-12+deb13u3 (DLA-4621-1 for bullseye, Debian bug 1132499, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-4046). The one glibc build published in the DHI Debian repository is Debian's 2.41-12+deb13u4 rebuilt for DHI, on amd64 and arm64; the version banner in its libc.so.6 names that Debian release (glibc 2.41). We checked the libc6 package of that build for both architectures against the repository index checksum: the Debian changelog it ships carries the 2.41-12+deb13u3 entry that applies the upstream stable-branch fix for CVE-2026-4046. The range ends at that build.
